name: Boss Ting
source:
the Red Flower Society executive and owner of Show Club NASA, where male dancers perform burlesque dances.
He is the most senior of the executives and has had a long career.
He is a good judge of trends, and thanks to his opportunism, he has been able to hold on to his position within the organization.
Behind the scenes, he has been locking up and killing boys he met on a gay dating app, and was purged by Yvet when he turned his venom on Dog Head's son, Johnny.
